ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) central surface to low-intensity (black/dark-brown) peripheral regions and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) mask across the center of both lobes; low-intensity contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge; a vertical low-intensity pillar-like formation extending from the peduncle base toward the center; small isolated low-intensity circular clusters in the lower right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged peaks (serrations) along the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude variations localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly concave sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips, creating a tapered, aerodynamic profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density dark clusters visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; three distinct dark circular pixel clusters located on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single diagonal low-intensity linear mark extending from the left side of the median notch; faint horizontal parallel striations (rake marks) visible on the right lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular dark pigmentation and structural thickening at the median notch and both lobe tips, consistent with localized trauma or parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical dark marking at the fluke-peduncle junction forming a distinct inverted 'T' shape.
